sections.heading: Overview

sections.content: The NSW Health Linen project will relocate HealthShare NSW’s Parramatta Linen Service and expand linen processing and distribution capacity to meet the forecast volume of public hospital linen. The preferred option requires a new, single-site linen processing facility that will meet the projected demand for the Sydney metro area. Site acquisition is required and the new facility will be developed as either a new development on a parcel of land (greenfield), or the adaptation of an existing industrial warehouse facility (brownfield).
sections.heading: Project goals

sections.content:
Key deliverables for the engagement include:
- Develop equipment baseline by process.
- Consult with operation teams and test assumptions.
- Document heat supply strategy, centralised and distributed plant models.
- Coordination with design consultant on functional layouts.
- Development of operator efficiency targets.
- Test and agree strategy with operational SMEs.
- Development of Performance Specification/ Project Scope documentation.
- Inventory streamlining strategy
